stories.headline: Why is the US sanctioning the International Criminal Court?
stories.description: The sanctions targeting the ICC, which prosecutes humanitarian crimes, are the latest move by the US against the court.

stories.headline: Abbas postpones Palestinian legislative elections to September 2027
stories.description: November 2026 vote delayed; joint presidential and legislative elections set for next year, president says in decree.

stories.headline: Has Yemen returned to ‘full-scale war’?
stories.description: Fighting is intensifying between Yemeni government forces and Houthi rebel group.

stories.headline: ‘Anachronism’: Rubio’s civilisational rhetoric prompts pushback from Iran
stories.description: Rubio says threats to Western civilisation today ‘every bit as real as they were on the dramatic stage of antiquity’.

stories.headline: India’s ‘Cockroach’ leaders detained; New Delhi in lockdown
stories.description: Indian police crackdown appears to have prevented mass protests against the country’s election chief from taking place.
